name: Enhanced Eagle Eye
description: With this modification, Eagle Eye: allows you to copy your opponent's magic level; is buffed (expert allows to learn 5th level spells); eagle eye artifacts' vvalues are doubled; Eagle Eye specialists pry at enemy heroes as if they were under advanced 'Visions'.
author: Andruids

czech.name: Vylepšené orlí oko
czech.description: S vylepšenýcm orlím okem získáte schopnout sesílat kouzla na stejné úrovni magie jako váš protivník.
